title: Failure probability of the recursive junta learner
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let a relevant-coordinate finder be given for dimension $n$ and junta size $k$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ depend on at most $k$ coordinates. For every $\delta\in(0,1/2]$, the probability that the recursive learner either returns no tree or returns a decision tree that does not compute $f$ is at most $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: a relevant-coordinate finder for n and k
the target is a k-junta: it depends on some set of at most k coordinates
a learning parameter δ with 0 < δ ≤ 1/2
